deficiencies.cr6Correction: ADJUST PRESSURE AUTOMATIC DOOR CLOSER OF SELF-CLOSING FIRE DOOR BETWEEN WHEEL HOUSE AND STAIRWAY - CLOSED COMPLETELY NOW.

reviewAlerts.message: Cause cites insufficient periodic inspection but does not explain why the quarterly fire door check did not detect incomplete closure before PSC.
Contingency relies on "quarterly inspection" without responsible person, record format, or master verification.

reviewQuestions: When was the door closer pressure last adjusted, and who performed the check?
Why did the quarterly fire door inspection not identify incomplete closure before PSC?
What record (checklist / log) documents the last quarterly fire door inspection?
Who on board is responsible for maintaining fire door closers under the SMS?
After correcting this door, were all similar self-closing fire doors on board checked?
